source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Some single-use devices may be reprocessed, but the reprocessor must meet applicable FDA requirements","B":"Every single-use device may be reprocessed without validation, labeling review, or regulatory oversight","C":"FDA prohibits reprocessing every device labeled for single use regardless of device or process","D":"Hospital reprocessors are exempt from manufacturer-type FDA requirements for quality and safety"}}
source_row.rationale: FDA states that not all single-use devices are suitable for reprocessing, but some can be shown safe and effective through validated reprocessing. Third-party and hospital reprocessors are regulated as manufacturers and must meet applicable premarket, labeling, quality-system, and postmarket requirements.
source_row.source_detail: Current FDA guidance: not all SUDs are suitable for reprocessing; certain SUDs may be demonstrated safe/effective through validation; healthcare-facility reprocessors are subject to applicable manufacturer requirements.
source_row.source_name: FDA — Reprocessing Single-Use Medical Devices: Information for Health Care Facilities
source_row.stem: A hospital is considering reprocessing a device originally labeled for single use. Which statement is accurate?
